The '''Prefsbelt sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The Prefsbelt sector was a part of the [[Pentastar Alignment]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the "Blaudu Sextus system" mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Essential Atlas Online Companion'']] (in the Prefsbelt sector) was a mistake. [[Blaudu Sextus]] was in the [[Regulan system/Legends|Regulan system]], correctly listed in the appendix.<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31605450|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=jasonfry|date=2011-03-19|time=7:30 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802124300/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-162}}</ref>
